items.title: Intero Biosystems wants drugmakers to test on mini human intestines, not animals
items.summary: Intero Biosystems is selling lab-grown human intestines to drugmakers as regulators push for alternatives to animal testing, while the startup looks to scale production and expand its organoid technology.

items.title: CedarDB wants one database to handle both transactions and analytics, as AI agents raise the stakes
items.summary: Databases have traditionally been designed either for analytical data or for operational data. But database engine CedarDB supports both, and its approach has gained relevance with the rise of agentic AI.

items.title: Ambani’s Jio seeks to raise $3.2B in what could be India’s biggest IPO
items.summary: Jio plans to use most of its IPO proceeds to repay debt as it expands beyond telecom.

items.title: Flock CEO says its microphones detect ‘just gunshots’ — its website says different
items.summary: Langley’s comments come amid mounting scrutiny of Flock from privacy advocates, including the ACLU, and members of the public who are concerned about the misuse of its technology.

items.title: Colossal Biosciences announces new AI platform to help accelerate de-extinction efforts
items.summary: Colossal announced a new AI platform to help accelerate its de-extinction efforts and Peter Diamandis has launched a new fund to back startups who use it.

items.title: Flock CEO: We haven’t ‘fired’ any police departments as customers
items.summary: Flock CEO Garrett Langley said that the surveillance company has not canceled contracts of any police department or law enforcement agency, despite reports of abuse.

items.title: Electric vehicle sales in the US are showing signs of life
items.summary: The electric vehicle market in the U.S. has been growing for the last three consecutive quarters.

items.title: TimeTeller puts our internal clocks at the center of personalized medicine
items.summary: German startup TimeTeller has developed a saliva test kit to help anyone understand their circadian rhythm; it aims to reduce side effects from cancer treatments.

items.title: Ambrosia Energy will build a 10 GWh factory in Texas to make batteries for off-grid data centers
items.summary: Startup Ambrosia Energy will build a massive factory to crank out batteries to augment solar panels, creating a round-the-clock clean power plant.

items.title: Hiyd is a health tracker that attaches to the watch you already wear
items.summary: Former Apple engineers figured out how to get a biometric sensor to attach to your watch without any magnets or adhesives.

items.title: YouTube Music launches new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms
items.summary: The label will appear on the player page and include songs entirely generated by AI or partially, such as AI involved in composition and vocals.

items.title: Apate sends AI agents undercover to get scammed so they can gather fraud intelligence
items.summary: Most companies use AI agents to ship products faster or speed up workflows. Apate.ai sends them undercover to get scammed.

items.title: Mosqitter is turning its mosquito traps into an AI-powered surveillance network
items.summary: Mosqitter is turning its mosquito-trapping hardware into an AI-powered surveillance network designed to identify species, monitor populations, and provide earlier warnings of mosquito-borne disease risks.

items.title: Prismm helps banks keep inherited money in-house
items.summary: With Prismm, account holders can give designated family members access to their accounts and documents ahead of time.

items.title: Deezer will soon let you filter out AI-generated music
items.summary: Deezer said that the new toggle will be rolled out by the end of the year.

items.title: Zenzap raises $44M for its AI chat app that aims to replace WhatsApp in the workplace
items.summary: Zenzap is used by organizations including Starbucks and Taco Bell.

items.title: Floqer’s AI agents research sales prospects so teams don’t have to
items.summary: The problem Floqer is trying to solve is familiar to anyone who has worked in sales or revenue operations.

items.title: Netflix to lay off 1,000 staff amid intensifying competition for user attention
items.summary: Netflix said most of the cuts would affect its product, tech, legal, and human resources departments.
